Terms of use

Last updated: 1 August 2026. Template text — have it reviewed by a Canadian lawyer before publishing. These terms cover the website only; your booking is governed by your signed photography contract.

Copyright in the photographs

Under the Canadian Copyright Act, copyright in every photograph on this website belongs to Nishchay Photography. You may not copy, download, reproduce, crop, edit or republish any image without written permission. Clients receive a personal print release with their gallery, which permits personal printing and sharing but does not transfer copyright and does not permit commercial use.

Using this website

You may browse, link to and share pages of this site. You may not scrape it, use its content to train machine-learning models, republish its text, or use it in any way that misrepresents your relationship with the studio.

Accuracy of information

Prices, availability and turnaround times on this site are current at the time of publication and may change. Nothing on this website constitutes a binding offer. The figures that govern your booking are the ones in your written quote and signed contract.

Bookings and cancellations

Booking terms — retainers, payment schedules, cancellation, postponement, delivery timelines and the illness-and-emergency clause — are set out in your photography contract, which takes precedence over anything on this page. A retainer is non-refundable because it reserves a date we then decline other work for; postponement terms are handled separately and generously.

Third-party links

This site links to third-party services, including our client gallery platform and social media. We are not responsible for their content, terms or privacy practices.

Limitation of liability

This website is provided as-is. To the extent permitted by Ontario law, Nishchay Photography is not liable for any loss arising from the use of, or inability to use, this website.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada applicable in it.
